units.source_text: 雖然事情早晚都會敗露，但我不敢直接說出口，

en.t: Although the matter was bound to come out sooner or later, I was afraid to say it outright,

units.source_text: 所以想方設法加以掩飾，這一點正是我可悲的毛病之一，

en.t: so I would contrive some way to cover it up, and this was one of my sad defects,

units.source_text: 這與世人斥責與鄙視的「謊言」頗為相似，

en.t: and it was quite similar to the lies that people condemn and despise,

units.source_text: 可是，我幾乎從未為了牟取私利而去掩飾過，

en.t: yet I almost never covered things up in order to gain some private advantage,

units.source_text: 只是對氣氛驟變為掃興而感到窒息般的恐懼而已，

en.t: I was simply terrified, almost to the point of suffocation, by the sudden change of mood into disappointment,

units.source_text: 所以，即使知道對自己不利，也會竭盡全力去「拼命服務」。

en.t: so even when I knew it would hurt me, I would throw myself completely into that desperate service.

units.source_text: 雖說這種「拼命服務」被扭曲得微不足道，

en.t: Even if that desperate service was distorted into something trivial,

units.source_text: 甚或愚不可及，但出於「拼命服務」的心情，

en.t: or even into something utterly foolish, it came from the feeling of desperate service,

units.source_text: 許多場合下，我都會不自覺地掩飾上一兩句。

en.t: and in many situations I would unconsciously add a word or two to smooth things over.

units.source_text: 而且這種習性也常常被世上所謂的「正人君子」大肆利用）。

en.t: And this habit of mine was often greatly exploited by the so-called upright people of the world.
